paragraphs.text: We aim to deliver your order safely and within the estimated delivery time. We work with reliable delivery partners and our own delivery riders to serve customers across Pakistan.
1. Delivery Services
Depending on your location and order, we may use the following delivery services:
Bykea
TCS
PostEx
Our Own Delivery Riders
Our own delivery riders are available only within Karachi.
For customers in other cities of Pakistan, orders will generally be delivered through TCS, PostEx, or another suitable courier service.
2. Delivery Time
Karachi
Orders within Karachi are generally delivered within:
2 to 3 working days
Delivery through our own riders or other available delivery services may vary depending on the customer's location, order processing, and other circumstances.
Other Cities in Pakistan
Orders outside Karachi are generally delivered within:
7 to 10 working days
Delivery times may vary depending on the destination, courier service, weather conditions, public holidays, and other circumstances beyond our control.
3. Order Processing
Orders are normally processed after confirmation of the order and, where applicable, confirmation of payment.
Once your order has been dispatched, it will be handed over to the relevant delivery service for transportation to your provided address.
4. Delivery Address
Customers are responsible for providing a complete and accurate delivery address, contact number, and other required information when placing an order.
We will not be responsible for delays or failed deliveries caused by:
Incorrect or incomplete address
Incorrect contact information
Customer being unavailable to receive the order
Failure to respond to courier calls
Refusal to accept the parcel
Additional delivery charges may apply if a parcel needs to be re-dispatched due to an incorrect address or other customer-related issue.
5. Delivery Charges
Delivery charges may vary depending on:
Delivery location
Order size or weight
Courier service used
Applicable shipping rates
The applicable delivery charges will be communicated or displayed during the ordering process.
6. Cash on Delivery
Cash on Delivery (C.O.D.) is available only within Karachi City.
For customers outside Karachi, advance payment is required before the order is dispatched.
7. Delivery Delays
Although we aim to deliver orders within the stated timeframes, delays may occasionally occur due to circumstances beyond our control, including:
Weather conditions
Public holidays
Courier-related delays
Road closures or traffic conditions
Address or contact issues
Unexpected operational circumstances
The estimated delivery time is therefore not a guaranteed delivery date.
8. Receiving Your Order

Customers are advised to check the package at the time of delivery. If the package appears significantly damaged or tampered with, please inform us as soon as possible and provide relevant photos or videos.
For any delivery-related issue, please contact our customer support team with your order number and delivery details so that we can assist you.
9. Delivery Outside Pakistan
At present, our delivery policy applies to orders within Pakistan only. International delivery, if offered in the future, will be subject to separate shipping terms and charges.
10. Contact Us
If you have any questions regarding your order, shipment, or delivery status, please contact our customer support team. We will be happy to assist you.
Welcome to Glass Skin Store
At Glass Skin Store, we believe that healthy, beautiful skin starts with the right products and the right skincare routine.

We are an online skincare store dedicated to bringing you authentic, high-quality skincare and beauty products from trusted and reputable brands. Our goal is simple: to make quality skincare more accessible while giving our customers a convenient and reliable shopping experience.

Whether you're looking to build a simple everyday routine, address specific skin concerns, or simply maintain healthy and radiant skin, we aim to provide products that fit different skin types, needs, and skincare goals.
Our Mission
Our mission is to help you discover skincare products that make you feel confident in your own skin.

We carefully select the products we offer, focusing on quality, authenticity, and customer satisfaction. We understand that skincare is personal, which is why we want to create a store where you can shop with confidence and find products that suit your individual needs.
Authentic Products You Can Trust
We understand how important authenticity is when it comes to skincare and cosmetics. That's why we strive to source our products from reliable and trusted brands and suppliers.
We believe you should know what you're putting on your skin, and we are committed to providing genuine products while maintaining clear and honest information about our products.
Skincare for Everyone
Every person's skin is different. There is no single skincare routine that works for everyone.

At Glass Skin Store, we aim to offer a variety of products for different skin types, concerns, preferences, and budgets. Whether your goal is hydration, a brighter-looking complexion, smoother-looking skin, or maintaining your everyday skincare routine, we're here to help you explore your options.
Our Commitment to You
Your experience matters to us.
From selecting products to processing your order and delivering it to your doorstep, we aim to make every part of your shopping experience as smooth as possible.
We are committed to:
Offering authentic and quality skincare products
Providing a convenient online shopping experience
Handling orders with care
Providing reliable delivery across Pakistan
Maintaining transparent store policies
Supporting our customers when they need assistance
More Than Just a Skincare Store
Glass Skin Store is more than a place to purchase skincare products. We want to become a trusted part of your skincare journey.
We believe skincare is not about chasing perfection. It's about taking care of yourself, understanding your skin, and finding products that work for you.
Whether you're starting your skincare journey or already have a routine you love, we're happy to be a part of it.
Because your skin deserves the best. 🤍
Glass Skin Store Real Skincare. Lasting Glow.

We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. If you receive a product that is damaged, defective, incorrect, or otherwise eligible for return, you may request a return or exchange within 7 days of receiving your order, subject to the terms below.
1. Return & Exchange Period
Returns and exchanges must be requested within 7 days of receiving the order.
Requests made after 7 days will generally not be accepted.
To request a return or exchange, please contact our customer support team with your order number and relevant details.
For damaged or incorrect items, customers may be required to provide clear photos or videos of the product and packaging.
2. Eligible Products
A product may be eligible for return or exchange if:
You received the wrong product.
The product arrived damaged or defective.
The product is significantly different from what was ordered.
The product is unused, unopened, and in its original condition and packaging, where applicable.
For hygiene and safety reasons, opened, used, tested, or tampered cosmetics products may not be eligible for return or exchange, unless the product was defective, damaged, or incorrectly supplied.
3. Non-Returnable Products
The following products generally cannot be returned or exchanged:
Products that have been opened or used.
Products that have been tested or applied to the skin.
Products with removed or damaged seals.
Products without their original packaging.
Products damaged due to customer misuse or improper storage.
Products returned after the 7-day return period.
Products that are otherwise unsuitable for resale due to hygiene or safety concerns.
4. Change of Mind
If you simply change your mind after receiving the product, the product must be unused, unopened, sealed, and in its original condition to be considered for a return or exchange.
Approval of a change-of-mind return will be subject to our inspection of the product.
5. Return Shipping Charges
If the return is due to customer preference, change of mind, incorrect selection, or any other reason not caused by us, the customer will be responsible for the return shipping charges.
If we sent the wrong product or the product arrived damaged or defective, we will review the issue and may cover the applicable return shipping charges.
6. Refunds
Once the returned product is received and inspected, we will notify you whether the return has been approved.
If approved:
The refund will be processed through the applicable payment method, where possible.
The refund amount may exclude any applicable delivery or return shipping charges where the return is due to customer preference or change of mind.
Refund processing time may vary depending on the payment method or financial institution.
7. Exchanges
If you wish to exchange a product, the replacement will be subject to product availability.
If the requested replacement is unavailable, we may offer an alternative product or refund, subject to the applicable return conditions.
8. Cash on Delivery Orders
Cash on Delivery (C.O.D.) is available only within Karachi City.
For orders outside Karachi, advance payment is required before the order is dispatched.
Any refund for an eligible prepaid order will be processed according to the applicable refund procedure.
9. Order Cancellation
Orders may be cancelled within 24 hours of placing the order.
After 24 hours, cancellation may not be possible if the order has already been processed or dispatched.
10. How to Request a Return or Exchange
To request a return or exchange, please contact us within 7 days of receiving your order and provide:
Order number
Customer name
Product name
Reason for return or exchange
Clear photos/videos, where applicable
Our team will review the request and provide further instructions.
11. Important Note

Due to the nature of cosmetics and personal-care products, we take hygiene and product safety seriously. Products must be returned in a condition that allows us to verify their eligibility for return or exchange.
We reserve the right to refuse a return or exchange if the product does not meet the conditions stated in this policy.
For any questions regarding returns or exchanges, please contact our customer support team.
We want to make sure our customers have a smooth and transparent shopping experience. Please read the following refund terms before placing your order.
1. Order Cancellation
Customers may cancel their order within 24 hours of placing the order.
If the order is cancelled within this period, the eligible amount will be refunded according to the original payment method, where applicable.
After 24 hours, cancellation may not be possible if the order has already been processed or dispatched.
2. Refund for Returned Products
For eligible returns, a refund will only be processed after we receive the returned product safely and inspect it.
The product must meet the applicable conditions stated in our Returns & Exchange Policy.
3. Products in Transit
We will not issue a refund while the returned product is still in transit.
The refund process will begin only after the product has been delivered back to us and successfully inspected.
4. Return Shipping Charges
If a customer returns a product due to a change of mind, personal preference, or any other reason not caused by us, the customer will be responsible for the return shipping charges.
If the product was damaged, defective, or incorrectly supplied by us, the return will be reviewed accordingly.
5. Refund Processing
Once the returned product has been received and approved, the refund will be processed through the applicable payment method.
Processing times may vary depending on the payment provider or bank.
6. Contact Us
For any refund-related questions, please contact our customer support team with your order number and relevant details.
Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit or purchase from our website.
1. Information We Collect
When you place an order or contact us, we may collect information such as:
Name
Phone number
Email address
Delivery address
Payment and order details
2. How We Use Your Information
We use your information to:
Process and deliver your orders
Contact you regarding your order
Process payments where applicable
Provide customer support
Improve our products and services
Send promotional updates, where permitted
3. Information Protection
We take reasonable measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure.
We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.
4. Third-Party Services
We may share necessary information with trusted delivery companies, payment providers, or service providers only when required to process and deliver your order or provide our services.
5. Cookies
Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience, understand website usage, and provide relevant content or services.
6. Your Privacy
By using our website, you agree to the collection and use of information as described in this Privacy Policy.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page.
7. Contact Us
If you have any questions about our Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, please contact us through the contact details provided on our website.

Welcome to Glass Skin Store. By accessing our website, browsing our products, placing an order, or purchasing from us, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. Please read them carefully before placing your order.
Glass Skin Store is an online skincare and cosmetics store serving customers across Pakistan. We aim to provide authentic, high-quality skincare and beauty products from trusted brands and suppliers.
1. Products & Product Information
We make every reasonable effort to ensure that the product information displayed on our website is accurate and up to date.
Product information may include:
Product name and description
Product images
Ingredients
Size or quantity
Usage instructions
Brand information
Price and availability
Please note that product packaging, labels, colors, designs, or ingredients may occasionally change due to updates made by the manufacturer.
Customers are encouraged to read the product packaging, ingredients, instructions, and warnings before using any product.
2. Product Authenticity
At Glass Skin Store, we are committed to providing genuine skincare and cosmetic products sourced from trusted brands and suppliers.
We do not intentionally sell counterfeit or imitation products.

If you believe that you have received a product that is incorrect or not genuine, please contact us immediately with your order details and supporting photographs or videos so that we can investigate the matter.
3. Prices & Availability
All prices displayed on our website are in Pakistani Rupees (PKR) unless otherwise stated.
Product prices, availability, discounts, and promotional offers may change without prior notice.
While we make every effort to ensure that pricing information is accurate, occasional errors may occur.
If an incorrect price is displayed:
If the correct price is lower, we may adjust the order accordingly.
If the correct price is higher, we may contact you for confirmation before processing the order.
If you do not agree to the corrected price, we may cancel the order.
Glass Skin Store reserves the right to correct pricing errors and cancel orders affected by such errors.
4. Payment Methods
Glass Skin Store currently accepts the following payment methods:
JazzCash
Easypaisa
Bank Transfer
Cash on Delivery (C.O.D.)
For JazzCash, Easypaisa, and Bank Transfer orders, customers may be required to provide payment confirmation or transaction details before the order is processed.
Cash on Delivery
Cash on Delivery (C.O.D.) is available only within Karachi City.
For all other cities and locations across Pakistan, customers must make full advance payment through one of our available online payment methods:
JazzCash
Easypaisa
Bank Transfer
C.O.D. is not available for deliveries outside Karachi City.
Glass Skin Store reserves the right to restrict or refuse C.O.D. orders where necessary.
5. Order Confirmation & Acceptance
After placing an order, you may receive an order confirmation through WhatsApp, phone call, SMS, email, or another available communication method.
An order confirmation does not necessarily guarantee that the order has been accepted or dispatched.
We reserve the right to cancel or refuse an order in circumstances including:
Product unavailability
Incorrect pricing
Incorrect or incomplete customer information
Payment verification issues
Suspected fraudulent activity
Duplicate or unusual orders
Delivery limitations
Violation of these Terms & Conditions
If an order is canceled after an advance payment has been received, any eligible refund will be processed according to our applicable refund procedure.
6. Order Cancellation
Customers may request cancellation of an order within 24 hours of placing the order.
To request cancellation, please contact us within the 24-hour period and provide your order number.
Once the 24-hour cancellation period has expired, the order may no longer be eligible for cancellation.
Orders that have already been processed or dispatched may not be canceled.
If an order has been dispatched, the customer may need to receive the order and follow the applicable Return Policy.
For orders paid in advance, any approved refund will be processed after verification and according to the applicable payment/refund procedure.
7. Delivery & Shipping
Glass Skin Store delivers skincare and cosmetic products to locations across Pakistan where courier services are available.
Delivery times may vary depending on the customer's location, courier service, weather conditions, public holidays, and other circumstances beyond our control.
We are not responsible for delays caused by:
Courier companies
Weather conditions
Public holidays
Strikes
Transportation problems
Incorrect or incomplete delivery information
Unforeseen circumstances beyond our reasonable control
Customers are responsible for providing a complete and accurate delivery address and a valid contact number.
If a parcel cannot be delivered because of an incorrect address, unavailable recipient, or failure to receive the parcel, additional delivery charges may apply for re-shipping.
8. Cash on Delivery Policy
C.O.D. is available only for customers within Karachi City.
Customers outside Karachi must pay the full order amount in advance.
For Karachi C.O.D. orders:
Payment must be made in full at the time of delivery.
Customers should ensure that someone is available to receive the parcel.
Repeated refusal or non-acceptance of C.O.D. orders may result in restrictions on future C.O.D. purchases.
C.O.D. availability may be restricted for certain orders at the discretion of Glass Skin Store.
9. Returns & Exchanges
Due to the hygienic and personal-care nature of skincare and cosmetic products, returns and exchanges are subject to strict conditions.
A return or exchange may be considered where the customer receives:
The wrong product
A damaged product
A defective product
A missing product
A product that materially differs from the product ordered
For hygiene and safety reasons, we generally do not accept returns or exchanges for products that have been:
Opened
Used
Applied to the skin
Swatched
Tampered with
Removed from their original packaging
Returned without their original seal or packaging
All return and exchange requests are subject to verification and approval by Glass Skin Store.
10. Return Shipping Charges

If a customer wants to return a product for a reason that is not due to an error, damage, or defect caused by Glass Skin Store, the customer will be responsible for the return shipping/courier charges.
The customer must arrange and pay for the return shipment unless Glass Skin Store agrees otherwise.
If the return is approved because Glass Skin Store sent the wrong or defective product, the return shipping arrangements may be handled separately after verification.
11. Return Procedure
Customers must contact Glass Skin Store before sending any product back.
Please provide:
Order number
Customer name
Reason for return
Clear photographs or videos of the product, where applicable
Do not send a product back without receiving return instructions or approval from Glass Skin Store.
Products returned without prior approval may not be accepted.
Returned products must meet the applicable return conditions and must be in an acceptable condition with their original packaging and seals where required.
12. Damaged or Incorrect Orders
Customers should inspect their parcel as soon as it is delivered.
If you receive a damaged, incorrect, defective, or incomplete order, please contact us promptly.
We may request clear photographs or videos showing:
The product
Product packaging
Courier packaging
Shipping label
Damaged area
Any other relevant information
Customers should retain the original product and packaging until the issue has been resolved.
After verification, Glass Skin Store may offer an appropriate resolution, such as replacement, exchange, or refund, depending on the circumstances.
13. Skincare & Cosmetic Safety
Skincare and cosmetic products may affect individuals differently.
Glass Skin Store does not guarantee that a particular product will produce a specific result because individual skin types, sensitivities, conditions, and responses can vary.
Customers should carefully read the product instructions, ingredients, warnings, and recommended usage before applying any product.
If you have sensitive skin, allergies, an existing skin condition, or concerns about a particular ingredient, we recommend consulting a qualified healthcare professional before using the product.
14. Allergies & Skin Reactions
Some skincare and cosmetic products may contain ingredients that can cause irritation or allergic reactions in certain individuals.
Customers are responsible for checking the product's ingredients and warnings before use.
Where appropriate, customers should perform a patch test and follow the manufacturer's recommended instructions.
If you experience significant irritation, discomfort, or an unexpected reaction, discontinue use and seek appropriate medical or professional advice.
Glass Skin Store cannot guarantee that every product will be suitable for every individual's skin.
15. Product Expiry & Storage
Customers should check the product packaging for:
Expiry date
Batch information
Usage instructions
Storage requirements
Products should be stored according to the manufacturer's recommendations.
Glass Skin Store is not responsible for damage caused by improper storage or handling after the product has been delivered to the customer.
16. Promotions & Discounts
Glass Skin Store may offer discounts, promotional codes, bundles, special offers, and other promotional campaigns from time to time.
Promotional offers may:
Have a limited validity period
Apply only to selected products
Require a minimum purchase
Be subject to specific conditions
Not be combined with other offers
We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or withdraw any promotional offer without prior notice.
17. Customer Information
Customers must provide accurate and complete information when placing an order, including:
Full name
Complete delivery address
Phone number
Email address, where applicable
Glass Skin Store is not responsible for delivery problems, delays, or additional charges resulting from incorrect or incomplete information provided by the customer.
18. User Accounts
If you create an account with Glass Skin Store, you are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and account information.
You agree to provide accurate and up-to-date information.
You are responsible for activities carried out through your account.
We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts associated with fraudulent, abusive, or unauthorized activity.
19. Marketing Communications
If you voluntarily subscribe to our marketing communications, you may receive information regarding:
New products
Skincare launches
Discounts
Special offers
Promotional campaigns
Product reviews
Customer feedback requests
Order-related updates
You may unsubscribe from promotional communications at any time by following the instructions provided in the relevant communication or by contacting us directly.
Receiving marketing communications is not required to make a purchase.
20. Website Use
You agree to use the Glass Skin Store website only for lawful purposes.
You must not:
Use our website for fraudulent or unlawful activities
Provide false or misleading information
Attempt unauthorized access to our website or systems
Interfere with the operation or security of our website
Copy website content without permission
Use our website content for unauthorized commercial purposes
Glass Skin Store reserves the right to restrict or terminate access where necessary.
21. Third-Party Brands
Glass Skin Store may sell products manufactured by third-party skincare and cosmetic brands.
The trademarks, logos, product names, and intellectual property of those brands remain the property of their respective owners.
Glass Skin Store is not the manufacturer of third-party products unless specifically stated otherwise.
Product information may be based on information provided by the relevant manufacturer, brand, or supplier.
22. Limitation of Liability
To the extent permitted by applicable law, Glass Skin Store shall not be responsible for indirect or consequential losses arising from the use of our website or products.

Glass Skin Store is not responsible for individual allergic reactions, sensitivities, or skin reactions resulting from the use of a product where the product has not been shown to be defective and has been used contrary to or outside the manufacturer's instructions.
Customers are responsible for reading product information, ingredients, warnings, and instructions before use.
Nothing in these Terms & Conditions is intended to exclude or limit any rights or protections that cannot legally be excluded under applicable law.
23. Changes to These Terms & Conditions
Glass Skin Store reserves the right to update or modify these Terms & Conditions from time to time.
Any changes will become effective when the updated Terms & Conditions are published on this page.
Customers are encouraged to review this page periodically.
24. Contact Us
If you have any questions regarding these Terms & Conditions, orders, payments, deliveries, products, returns, or exchanges, please contact us:
Glass Skin Store
